parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the keyboard, made of durable ABS plastic that holds all keys and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the key switches and electronic circuits.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Tilt Leg
parts.Basic_description: A small foldable leg under the keyboard made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Used to adjust the typing angle of the keyboard.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates outward or inward to change keyboard tilt.

parts.name: Tilt Leg
parts.Basic_description: A small foldable leg under the keyboard made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Used to adjust the typing angle of the keyboard.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates outward or inward to change keyboard tilt.

parts.name: Cord
parts.Basic_description: A flexible electrical cord connecting the keyboard to a computer.
parts.Functional_description: Transmits electrical signals between the keyboard and computer.
parts.Movement_description: Flexible; can bend and move freely.

parts.name: Plug Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The USB plug head that connects the keyboard to a computer port.
parts.Functional_description: Provides electrical and data connection between keyboard and computer.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary when plugged in; detachable when disconnected.
